description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Nelliya, Ibbagamuwa D/S Division, Kurunegala District (25/0014)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, including declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, registration of land ownership, and land title settlements under the Registration of Title Act. The content focuses on land parcels, cadastral maps, property ownership details, and title settlements in specific locations, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
